content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a hosting service that allows you to publish static websites directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means you can set up a fully functional online store to sell products such as ebooks, courses, and templates without incurring platform fees. Unlike services like Gumroad, which charges 10% per sale, using GitHub Pages in conjunction with NOWPayments can significantly reduce your costs, allowing you to retain more profit and maintain sovereignty over your sales.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind using GitHub Pages for your online store involves several components working seamlessly together. GitHub Pages serves as the front-end for hosting your store, while backend logic can be managed with tools like Google Apps Script. The final piece is NOWPayments, which handles automatic crypto payment processing. This setup not only minimizes costs but also ensures that you have full control over your data and transactions without relying on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in countries with limited access to conventional payment solutions. If you're selling ebooks, courses, or digital templates in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are not available, GitHub Pages offers a reliable way to establish your online presence. By deploying this stack, you can take charge of your business and avoid excessive fees while providing your customers with a straightforward purchasing experience.
GitHub Pages allows you to host your store for free, saving you significant costs.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of this stack comes from its integration of several key components. GitHub Pages hosts your content, showcasing your digital products in a user-friendly manner. Google Apps Script provides the backend logic to handle orders, while NOWPayments facilitates instant crypto payment processing. This combination creates a robust system that empowers you to sell digital goods without the limitations typically imposed by mainstream platforms, ensuring that you keep the majority of your revenue.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, create a GitHub repository where you will host your product files. Use Google Apps Script to set up order processing and integrate NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. You can then publish your site on GitHub Pages and begin promoting your offerings. For those looking for a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your setup process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using GitHub Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This allows you to avoid platform fees and maintain full control over your sales. By leveraging this infrastructure, you keep more of your earnings and ensure a smooth purchasing process for your customers.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, far less than platforms like Gumroad.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

Yes, by hosting your templates and fonts on GitHub Pages and using NOWPayments for transactions, you can sell without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, effectively eliminating their fees.
What are the benefits of using GitHub Pages for my store?
GitHub Pages offers free hosting, complete control over your content, and no platform fees. It allows you to establish a professional online presence without financial barriers.
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my GitHub Pages store?
You can integrate NOWPayments by using their API or webhooks with Google Apps Script to handle transactions. This enables automatic payment processing for your digital products.
